public_health_question.v: To what extent are high-contact household objects and surfaces contaminated with monkeypox virus in the home of two persons with monkeypox?

ev.q: To assess the presence and degree of surface contamination of household objects contacted by monkeypox patients, UDHHS swabbed objects
High-Contact Object and Surface Contamination in a Household of Persons with Monkeypox Virus Infection
Specimens were obtained from 30 objects in nine areas of the home
They performed targeted environmental sampling using published methods
the patients also described cleaning and disinfection activities performed within the home during their illness

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is reported; the report describes environmental specimens from one household.

notes: The design is not named; case report/series is inferred for an environmental sampling assessment of one household. The positivity breakdown by surface type (porous 3/3, nonporous 17/25, mixed 1/2) is read as description, not a comparison; a reader could treat it as a side-by-side comparison and set data_focus to yes.
